queries.sql: select "users"."id", "users"."email", "users_posts"."data" as "posts" from "account" "users" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("users_posts"."id", "users_posts"."title")), '[]'::json) as "data" from "post" "users_posts" where "users_posts"."author" = "users"."id") "users_posts" on true where ("users"."id" >= $1 and "users"."id" < $2)
